title: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
PREVENTION OF CRUELTY TO ANIMALS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act
1890
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 14th
November, 2001 ]
No. Legis.13-53/2001, dated 13-11-2001.--The
following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the Punjab is hereby
published for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
